verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs say it deposits checks by mailing them directly to your bank of deposit, so the paper never reaches you. The service costs $20 per check, with free overnight shipping to Bank of America, Chase, and Wells Fargo. That covers the core hands-off deposit, but the story's endorsement and reconciliation steps are not addressed, and deposit relies on physically shipping the check to the bank rather than the provider depositing it itself. Missing for 10: evidence that the provider endorses checks, reconciliation or deposit-confirmation tracking (e.g. syncing to accounting), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the deposit workflow.
